paliers.title: Discount tiers
paliers.description: The discount is decided once per wave, from the fish tonnage that wave targets, then applied to the feed cost of the whole wave, across all feed grades. The tier applied is the one with the highest threshold among those less than or equal to that tonnage. Thresholds must be strictly increasing (checked on save). Two tiers cannot share the same evaluation order: each order must be unique, otherwise saving is rejected.
paliers.seuilHint: In tonnes of fish targeted per wave: the tier applies as soon as the target tonnage reaches this threshold.

sections.ventilations: Breakdowns (by contribution type, by expense line)

totalEntrees.label: Total income (FCFA)
totalEntrees.formule: Total monthly income = revenue (sales value of the batches harvested this month) + capital contributions recorded this month.

resultatMois.label: Monthly result (FCFA)
resultatMois.formule: Monthly result = revenue + contributions - total expenses for this month.

empoissonne.label: Stocked (t)
empoissonne.formule: Monthly stocked biomass = target biomass (target weight x expected fingerling count) of the batches STOCKED this month, summed across every batch concerned.

ventes.label: Sales (t)
ventes.formule: Monthly sales = harvested biomass (target weight x expected fingerling count) of the batches whose harvest month falls this month.

alevinsCommander.label: Fingerlings to order (#)
alevinsCommander.formule: Monthly fingerlings to order = number of fingerlings to order (number of fish to sell increased by the fingerling safety margin, rounded up) for the batches stocked this month.

besoinAliments.label: Feed requirement (kg)
besoinAliments.formule: Monthly feed requirement = sum, across every feed grade, of the raw feed requirement (before rounding to bags) scheduled this month for all batches.

sacsAchat.label: Bags to buy (total)
sacsAchat.formule: Monthly bags to buy = sum, across every feed grade, of the bags rounded up needed this month.

sacsGranulometrie.label: of which {granule} bags (total)
sacsGranulometrie.formule: Monthly {granule} bags = feed requirement of this grade this month, rounded up to a full bag.

detailSacsParVague.label: {granule} bags consumed (indicative) — Month {count} of the cycle
detailSacsParVague.formule: Indicative {granule} bags consumed (ROUND) — Month {count} of the cycle = sum, across every batch stocked {count} month(s) earlier, of that month's {granule} feed requirement, rounded to the nearest bag. Distinct from "of which {granule} bags (total)" above, which is the number of bags TO BUY (rounded UP, ceil) — this line must never be used to place an order.

revenus.label: Revenue (FCFA)
revenus.formule: Monthly revenue = biomass harvested this month (target weight x expected fingerling count) x selling price per kg, for batches whose harvest month falls this month.

epargneConseillee.label: Recommended savings (FCFA)
epargneConseillee.formule: Monthly recommended savings = monthly result x savings rate (Parameters), never negative even when the monthly result is.

coutAliments.label: Feed cost (FCFA)
coutAliments.formule: Monthly feed cost = sum of the feed costs (calculated bags x price per bag, tier discount applied) scheduled this month for all batches and feed grades.

coutAlevins.label: Fingerling cost (FCFA)
coutAlevins.formule: Monthly fingerling cost = number of fingerlings to order (number of fish to sell increased by the fingerling safety margin, rounded up) x fingerling unit price, for batches stocked this month. The fingerling safety margin (Parameters) is applied here, but not to the expected revenue nor to the feed needs.

chargesReparties.label: Shared expenses (FCFA)
chargesReparties.formule: Monthly shared expenses = expenses of lines included in the cost-sharing base + general journal expenses (operational category, no assigned batch), shared between active batches this month.

investissements.label: Capital expenses (FCFA)
investissements.formule: Monthly capital expenses = sum of journal expenses of Capital expense category entered this month.

depensesTotales.label: Total expenses (FCFA)
depensesTotales.formule: Total monthly expenses = feed cost + fingerling cost + shared expenses + capital expenses for this month.

apports.label: Contributions (FCFA)
apports.formule: Monthly contributions = sum of the capital contributions recorded this month.

soldeCumule.label: Cumulative balance (FCFA)
soldeCumule.formule: Cumulative balance = previous month's balance + revenue - expenses + contributions for this month.

apportParType.label: Contributions — {type} (FCFA)
apportParType.formule: Monthly contributions of type {type} = sum of the capital contributions of this type recorded this month. The sum of both types (Equity + Loan received) reconstructs exactly the "Contributions (FCFA)" line.

depenseParPoste.label: Expenses — {poste} (FCFA)
depenseParPoste.formule: Monthly expenses of the "{poste}" line = sum of the monthly charges for this line this month (only lines included in the cost-sharing base). Together with the other lines and the general journal, reconstructs exactly the "Shared expenses (FCFA)" line.

depenseJournalGeneral.label: Expenses — General journal, not assigned to a batch (FCFA)
depenseJournalGeneral.formule: Monthly general journal = journal expenses of Operational category, with no assigned batch, recorded this month. Excludes journal expenses already assigned to a batch (already counted in its direct share) and capital expenses. Together with the lines above, reconstructs exactly the "Shared expenses (FCFA)" line.

caveatReel.description: No contribution, subsidy or loan actually received is currently tracked in the application's actual data — only actual expenses and sales feed the "Actual" curve. As soon as a contribution has actually been received, this curve is therefore biased downward compared to actual cash flow. Planned contributions remain visible on the "Initial budget" and "Updated forecast" curves.
